name: REVOLUTIONARIES NEVER DIE - Mohanad Yaqubi
description: This event presents "REVOLUTIONARIES NEVER DIE" by Mohanad Yaqubi, a film that revisits Jocelyne Saab's archive of conflicts and revolutions in the Arab world between 1973 and 1983. The film explores how these images of struggle and solidarity were viewed, used, and transmitted.
longDescription:
The Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery hosts "REVOLUTIONARIES NEVER DIE" by Mohanad Yaqubi on November 22, 2026, at 21:15. The film has a duration of 81 minutes and no intermission. It is promoted by the Câmara Municipal de Matosinhos.

The film delves into the archive of Jocelyne Saab, who documented conflicts and revolutions across various Arab countries from 1973 to 1983. Mohanad Yaqubi re-examines these images, focusing on themes of struggle and solidarity, and questioning their reception, application, and dissemination.

Admission to the event is free. The age classification for the event is 16 years and older. Parking is available at Docapesca Parking for 1.05 euros with a ticket for the show.
